note_tweet.text: Pretty hard. This plugin is built around Grok Bot’s local roster cache and webhook routines. OpenAI Dots have no public API or similar desktop cache—they live inside ChatGPT and use plugins plus MCP events. The floating UI and eye-tracking could be reused with Dot-style avatars, but the connection side would need a full rewrite, maybe via the Agents API or a proxy. Doable for a motivated builder, not a quick port.
